title: Ruch i dźwięk. Urządzenia elektroniczne w muzyce (PKF 51A/72) / Movement and sound. Electronic devices in music
license: WFDiF, all rights reserved (FINA Regulamin: "Wszelkie kopiowanie materiałów jest zabronione"); PKF foreign-exchange material, shot in Berlin
notes: Polska Kronika Filmowa 51A/1972, an item whose subject is electronic devices in music: an oil-projection liquid light show, op-art concentric squares and starbursts thrown on a wall, a light-drawn squiggle, a synthesizer on screen, a fisheye face, cut against a corn harvest. Shot in Berlin, PL newsreel, Polish.
